name: Battery level and charging state
plain: Reads battery percent and whether the phone is plugged in, with no prompt.
meaning: Shows routine (charging overnight at home) and pairs with other signals to track a device. Apps use it for power-aware sync; Olejnik et al. showed level and discharge time can tag a device briefly.

android.note: Level is integer 0 to 100; plugged type AC, USB, wireless

ios.note: Returns -1.0 in the simulator or when monitoring is off

limits.headline: Can see your battery percent and if the phone is charging, with no prompt
limits.user_action: Nothing. The app checks while it is open
can: See your battery level from 0 to 100
See if the phone is plugged in and whether it is on a charger, USB or wireless (Android)
Watch the level change while the app is open
Use it to change app behavior, such as pausing downloads
cannot: See battery health or cycle count
Get a real level in the iPhone simulator, which returns minus one
See your level on iPhone unless it turns monitoring on first
Show your exact reading to others by itself
limits.differs: Android shares the level through a system broadcast. iPhone apps must turn on battery monitoring first.

story.what_it_is: An app can see your battery percent and whether you are charging.
story.for_you: You never get asked. The app might delay a big download until you plug in. It might also learn that you charge overnight at home.
story.for_makers: Makers use it for smart syncing and to avoid draining your phone. Combined with other signals, battery level and charge state can tag a device for a short time.

use_cases.example: A game lowers frame rate and effects when your battery is below 20 percent.
A video app offers to download shows only while you are plugged in.
A running app warns you that your battery may not last the whole workout.
A navigation app suggests plugging in because your battery is low on a long trip.
An ad firm adds battery level to a short term device signature.
A ride app tells a driver to charge before accepting a long trip.

story.android_note: Read through a standard broadcast with no permission.
story.ios_note: Read through UIDevice battery monitoring, with no prompt.

technical_bounds: Fingerprint use is time limited because the level changes

abuse: Infer home location from charging times

history.change: Battery level moved from 5 percent to 1 percent steps
